interpretation: Wang Zhen's 1313 treatise describes established northern dryland farming and animal traction, combining earlier agronomy with observation. It also records the need for restoration after war. Use a maintained dryland-system analogue on Shuntian's existing fields, with the same assessment range as maintained Parisis fields. The treatise is not evidence that every recommended improvement was active locally.

assignment.range_role: Explicit regional management analogue, not a measured local score or population-fitted target. No additional hectares or irrigation assigned.

exclusions: Do not treat the publication of an agricultural manual as automatic activation of a country advance or policy.
No rice-system, second-harvest or extra irrigation bonus.
No population-derived cultivated-area reconstruction used as a location allocation.
Northern frontier controls retain their existing assignments.
